canonical_work.title: MunTTS: A Text-to-Speech System for Mundari
canonical_work.venue: Proceedings of the Seventh Workshop on the Use of Computational Methods in the Study of Endangered Languages (ComputEL-7)
canonical_work.scope_classification: Mundari-specific; Jharkhand Mundari; Devanagari-script speech/text corpus

dataset_manifestation.name: Mundari TTS Dataset Corpus
dataset_manifestation.collaboration_reported: FAIR Forward - Artificial Intelligence for all / GIZ
dataset_manifestation.repository_sample: 100 female-speaker recordings plus 100 male-speaker recordings, each paired with transcript text
dataset_manifestation.full_dataset_access: provider-mediated; README directs requests to data@karya.in

deterministic_dedup.canonicalization_rule: ACL paper, Microsoft code repository, Karya dataset repository and associated provider manifestations are related artifacts of the same MunTTS research/data project, not independent corroborating cultural sources. Dataset samples are manifestations, not additional source identities.

exact_locator_evidence_candidates.locator: ComputEL-7 proceedings printed p.76; PDF page 85; lines 5550-5566 in audited web extraction
exact_locator_evidence_candidates.supported_proposition: The paper presents MunTTS as an end-to-end text-to-speech system for Mundari and states that it gathered Mundari text and speech data and evaluated the system with native speakers and objective metrics.
exact_locator_evidence_candidates.promotion_state: exact-locator candidate; not yet inserted into controlled evidence ledger

exact_locator_evidence_candidates.locator: ComputEL-7 proceedings printed p.76; PDF page 85; lines 5602-5617 in audited web extraction
exact_locator_evidence_candidates.supported_proposition: The study states that it used Mundari spoken in Jharkhand and written in Devanagari, collected 15,656 unique sentences, and reports 26,868 audio recordings totaling 27.51 hours.
exact_locator_evidence_candidates.promotion_state: exact-locator candidate; not yet inserted into controlled evidence ledger

exact_locator_evidence_candidates.locator: Karya dataset README lines 190-213 in audited web extraction
exact_locator_evidence_candidates.supported_proposition: The current Karya dataset repository reports 26,870 recordings from two speakers, 32-bit PCM at 44.1 kHz, paired transcripts, a 200-recording public sample, and a provider-side full-corpus SHA1 file.
exact_locator_evidence_candidates.promotion_state: exact-locator candidate; count discrepancy with paper preserved, not reconciled away

count_discrepancy.rule: Do not silently normalize either count; preserve manifestation/version context until the full corpus hash/version history is verified.

license_constraints: software incorporation requires GPL under the stated license summary
rights_access_consent.privacy_publicity_notice: Repository license summary explicitly warns that publicity, privacy, moral or other rights may still apply.
rights_access_consent.redistribution_decision: Do not copy the full corpus into MLHKP. Metadata and exact scholarly locators may be registered; any audio/sample ingestion requires file-level license compliance plus speaker-consent/privacy/cultural-governance review.

quality_and_scope_controls.linguistic_scope_note: Evidence concerns the described Jharkhand Mundari/Devanagari corpus and TTS study; it must not be generalized to all Mundari varieties, Munda communities, cultural practices or periods.

controlled_promotion.reason: Exact locators are now captured, but controlled-ledger reconciliation, stable source-ID assignment, dataset-version/hash verification, and consent/privacy/cultural-governance checks remain required before promotion.
